query.en: Make an Instagram Story telling people where to find my stall at the market this Saturday. I sell hand-thrown ceramics. Warm clay background, a blue-and-cream striped awning across the top, a big serif headline 'Come find us at the market', a simple flat drawing of a few pots on a shelf, then a dark panel with where, when and what to bring, and my handle. Keep the top and bottom clear of Instagram's buttons. Use `—` for the market name, stall number and date I haven't given you.
